# Documentation index

This directory stores project documentation that is meant for contributors, agents, and maintainers rather than end-user website content.

## Scope

- repository onboarding and structure
- operational notes and reference docs
- contributor guidance and standards
- reusable doc templates and project references

## Organization

- `architecture/`: high-level architecture and repository context
- `templates/`: reusable doc and task templates

## Maintenance

Keep this index in sync with any new documentation category added under `.github/docs/`.
